question: What mastery and gifts does the goddess possess regarding past, present, and future time?
premises: The goddess is mistress of the three times.
The goddess is worshipped at the three times.
The goddess grants knowledge of the three times.
inference: She rules over all three times, receives worship across them, and bestows knowledge of them.
plain_english: She is mistress of the three times, is worshipped at all three times, and grants knowledge of past, present, and future.
